enuma.title: Enuma Elish (rework, jointed rig, hovering): draw, raise, 3 s charge, swing, 2 s beam sweep, recover

keys.caption: Idle key 0: arms folded, hovering, legs loose; Ea rises out of a gold ripple behind his right side
Anticipation: unfolds and curls down, hips turn right, right hand drops to Ea's hilt, knees tuck, eyes up
Raise, overshoot: Ea flung up on one straight arm past the top, chest arched open, left arm thrown out, legs trail
Settle, charge holds: Ea back upright, left fist braced low, white ball and red rings at the tip, grooves glow
Charge, strain: he rises and leans back into the wind, left forearm shields his face, legs blown back, drums faster
Wind-up: Ea cocked far back behind his head, left arm points at the arena, back arched, left knee drawn up, at his highest
Contact (hit): swung down side-on, both hands on Ea levelled at the arena, torso thrown into it, legs kicked back; white flash, beam
Beam drive: hips lead the sweep across the lanes, torso lags, both hands on Ea, legs braced back against the recoil
Beam end: the far side of the ring, recoil pushes him upright, Ea lifts, legs swing through
Recover = idle key 0: arms folded again, Ea sinks back into its ripple, drums slow

idle.title: Idle (rework, jointed rig, hovering): arms folded, breathing, looking down on the runners

keys.caption: Idle key 0: arms folded, chin up, weight hangs on his right leg, left knee loose
Breath in starts: chest rises, folded arms lift with it, legs drift forward
Breath in, top: chest out, he looks down his nose at the lanes
Glance: head turns to the runners on his left, shoulders follow a little, hips roll
Breath out: chest drops, weight swings onto his left leg, right knee loosens
Smug lean: hips sway to his left, head tips, fold tightens
Second breath in: chest lifts again, legs drift back under him
Glance the other way: over his right shoulder, chin high, hips counter-turn
Breath out, settling: head comes back front, weight returns to his right leg
Loop = idle key 0: arms folded, chin up, weight on his right leg

gates.title: Gates of Babylon (rework, jointed rig, hovering): a sweep of his right arm opens the portals, a command fires the volleys

keys.caption: Idle key 0, Dodge bar opens: arms folded, still; one gold dot behind his left shoulder
Coil: right hand unfolds and drops across to his left hip, torso twists left, eyes stay on the lanes; first portals open on his left
Sweep: the open hand swings up across his chest toward his right, torso unwinds; portals cascade behind him in its path
Raised hand, sweep's end: arm up and out to his right, chest open, chin high; all 16 portals open, weapon tips push through (held still)
Command (hit): arm snaps down to point at the lanes, torso thrown forward, legs kick back; volley 1 of 14 leaves on the gesture
Overshoot: the point carries past and down, head dips, legs swing further back; volley 2
Second gesture: weight swings to his left, left arm flung wide with an open palm, right fist drawn to his chest; volley 6
Commanding hold: turns back, right palm out over the lanes, left fist to his hip, chin up; volley 10
Volley 14, the last: the hand sinks, portals start to shrink and close
Recover = idle key 0: arms fold again, portals gone

shields.title: Shield Gates (rework, jointed rig, hovering): his left hand calls a ring of shields out of small portals, a fold locks it

keys.caption: Idle key 0: arms folded, still
Anticipation: left hand unfolds and sinks across his belly, shoulders hunch, torso turns right, knees tuck
Call: the open left hand sweeps up and out to his left; the first shield portal opens beside it
Hand high: left arm overhead, he leans back; portals open round the back in the hand's path
Overshoot: hand flung up and back, chest arched, head back, right arm drops; all 6 portals open, shields push half out
Spread: both arms flung up and wide in a V, palms out, the right lower; the shields come out to a full ring, portals fade
Gather: arms swing in toward his chest to fold, torso settles, the ring holds
Lock (Fortified): arms snap folded, chin up, a smirk; a gold pulse runs round the ring
Settle: the snap rocks him forward, head nods, legs swing through; the ring starts to orbit
End = idle key 0, Fortified: arms folded, the shield ring orbiting

rig: jointed (build_boss_king.py -- jointed): Torso, Head, upper and lower arm and leg per side, Key, Ea; the lower arm carries the hand, the lower leg the foot
units: XYZ Euler degrees about each part's joint, relative to its parent; root_offset in model units from the hover height (Z = Roblox Y up)
ea: Ea turns about its grip (the empty); ea_grip_offset moves the grip in the right lower arm's space, model units. ea_drum_spin: degrees about Ea's z; Ea_Drum1 and Ea_Drum3 turn +spin, Ea_Drum2 -spin (also in rotations)
effects: sketch labels per key: draw (gold ripple at Ea's grip), arrows (drum spin marks), charge (groove glow), ball:<size> (white ball and red rings at Ea's tip), wind, gather, flash (one white flash at the tip), beam (from Ea's tip along its axis), embers; the red arena tint runs with the charge and beam. Later moves: jportals:<f>[:tips|:close] (design C sun-wheel portals, the first f of them in his arm's sweep order), jvolley:<j> (volley j of 14 from them), jshields:<f>:<state>:<yaw> (shield portals and shields, state portal|emerge|ring|lock), cmd:<L|R> (the command flash at that hand)
